title: Parametrization and reduction to depth zero of $\overline{\mathbb{Z}}[\frac{1}{p}]$-blocks of tame $p$-adic groups
summary: Let $G$ be a reductive group over a non-archimedean local field $F$ of residue characteristic $p$. We consider pairs $(φ,I)$ consisting of a "wild inertia" Langlands parameter $φ: P_F \longrightarrow \hat{G}$ whose centralizer $C_{\hat{G}}(φ)$ is a Levi subgroup of $\hat{G}$, and a cohomological invariant $I$ whose definition is inspired by the theory of endoscopy.
